static_traits.name: Han Rui
static_traits.social_status: Having friends to chat about everyday matters, but finding it hard to build deeper connections out of fear of others' judgment of poetry; not yet discussing the sense of failure as a Poet with friends
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no previous similar psychological problems; never received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic, Neutral attitude, fairly cooperative; when discussing poetry feedback, often using absolutist expressions (such as 'complete failure'), prone to catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking

basic_info.main_problem: Feeling like a failure as a Poet, because believing no one appreciates my work.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because the sense of failure as a Poet started affecting my self-esteem and overall mood.
growth_experiences: About two years ago she began publicly sharing poetry; after each poetry reading event and online posting she receives little positive feedback or praise, and the sense of failure gradually intensified; she tried self-soothing and seeking recognition from friends but the effect was brief and her emotions remain continuously affected; for fear of being judged she avoids deeply discussing poetry-related feelings with friends, and social connection is restricted.

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' recognition

special_situations.event: After the poetry recitation event ended, there was little positive feedback or praise on site
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not received positive feedback, it means my poems are terrible, I am just a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-soothing before the next event, or doubling efforts to seek others' approval to relieve unease
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one likes my poems; I am just a failure

special_situations.event: After posting poetry works online, interaction and appreciation are few
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Lukewarm online response means no one appreciates my work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently monitors likes and comments to seek external validation, or shares less to avoid being set back again

special_situations.event: When thinking of honestly discussing the sense of failure as a Poet with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I show vulnerability, they will think I am too sensitive or not take me seriously
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids in-depth communication with friends, keeping distance to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not take me seriously; they will think I am too sensitive

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be seen, appreciated, and taken seriously (work Gaining recognition)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged, belittled, and not taken seriously, thereby having self-worth negated
defense_goal: Keeping distance to lower the risk of being negated
Depends on external validation to temporarily stabilize self-worth

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges or judges who do not take one seriously

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to publicly express feelings of failure about poetry to others (such as friends) or seek feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will belittle or not take one seriously like judges (tending to attribute inner worries to others' intentions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using vague and defensive expressions (such as 'they will think I am too sensitive'), avoiding specific details; restrained tone, reducing emotional exposure, to protect the self.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to more openly seek genuine feedback or express vulnerability to trusted people
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If showing need or vulnerability, it will be seen as 'despairing or dependent', thus losing respect
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing 'not wanting to appear despairing or needy', refusing deeper sharing with rational reasons; steady tone, logic-based, reducing emotional contact.

manifestations: Finds it hard to build deeper connections for fear of being judged
Not yet discussing the sense of failure as a Poet with friends, tending to bear it alone
Having uncertainty and Anxiety about whether others will take one seriously
outcomes: Social avoidance and Increased sense of isolation

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Constraining self-expression with the rule 'I do not want to appear despairing or needy'

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Presuming others will think one is 'too sensitive' or 'not take one seriously'

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Overly concerned with others' opinions, expresses cautiously
Avoiding deep communication out of fear of judgment

positive_force: Having a basic friend support network (though not yet discussing the sense of failure)
Stable occupational functioning (gun club Work not yet affected)
Willing to try collecting more accurate feedback and doing behavioral experiments to test beliefs
negative_force: Strongly depends on external validation to define self-worth
Cognitive biases are prominent (catastrophizing, overgeneralization, all-or-nothing thinking, mind reading)
Fearing being judged, avoiding deep interpersonal connections, Reinforcing isolation and the sense of failure

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-denial and sense of failure after sharing poems
antecedent: Receiving little praise after a poetry recitation event
Few interactions after posting works online
target_behavior.core_reason: Overly binding self-worth to others' feedback, catastrophically interpreting and overgeneralizing negative or inadequate feedback
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the threat of being negated, temporarily reducing uncertainty and Anxiety through Self-denial and avoidance
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-esteem, overall Low mood, Sleep and self-care are affected

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding deep discussion of the sense of failure with friends and keeping distance in Interpersonal relationships
antecedent: Thinking of honestly expressing the sense of failure as a Poet to friends
Facing social situations where one might be evaluated
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being judged or not taken seriously, tending toward mind-reading and outside attribution
target_behavior.function: Avoids negative evaluation to protect self-image and emotions
target_behavior.consequence: Difficulty building deeper connections, Increased sense of isolation, the problem not receiving outside support and correction
